How do I memoize a callback?

Wrap stable callbacks with useCallback when passing them to memoized children.

```tsx
const onSave = useCallback(() => save(data), [data]);
```

Show me a zod + react-hook-form setup.

Wire zodResolver into useForm and render field errors.

```tsx
const schema = z.object({ email: z.string().email() });
const form = useForm({ resolver: zodResolver(schema) });
<input {...form.register('email')} />
```

The resolver keeps client validation aligned with the schema.
